source: NEMA 17 stepper (NEMA ICS 16 frame, e.g. 17HS4401 datasheet): body 42.3 mm square, length 40 mm (body lengths 34 / 40 / 48 mm exist: set body_length from the request), 4 x M3 on a 31.0 mm square pattern, 22 mm pilot 2 mm high, 5 mm shaft 24 mm long from the mounting face with a flat.
frame: motor: axis along Z, origin on the mounting face at the shaft axis, body toward -Z, pilot and shaft toward +Z

body_size.source: datasheet: square frame (NEMA ICS 16 nominal 42.3 / 1.67 in)

body_length.source: datasheet 17HS4401: stack length; 34 and 48 mm variants exist, give it in the request

hole_pitch.source: datasheet / NEMA ICS 16: square bolt pattern

hole_thread_depth.source: datasheet: maximum screw engagement; a longer screw bottoms in the motor

screw_head_diameter.source: ISO 4762 M3 socket head dk, used as the screw keep-out

pilot_height.source: datasheet: pilot height above the face

shaft_length.source: datasheet: shaft length measured from the mounting face

shaft_flat_depth.source: assumed: D flat leaves 4.5 mm across flats (typical 17HS shaft); uncertainty +/- 0.1

shaft_flat_length.source: assumed: typical 17HS flat length; uncertainty +/- 3, measure the owner's motor

cable_exit_clearance.source: assumed: 4-pin lead leaves the rear or side; room for the bend radius; +/- 4

mount.notes: The motor bolts through a plate lying on FACE: plate hole = pilot_diameter plus a printing clearance (design_rules), four clearance holes on HOLE, screw length = plate thickness + at most hole_thread_depth. The pilot in its plate hole, the screws in HOLE and the face on the plate are designed contact.

notes: Datasheet values come from the plan's datasheet_note (42.3 square, 40 long, 31.0 square M3, 22 pilot 2 high, 5 shaft 24 long). Shaft flat depth/length, screw head dk (ISO 4762) and cable clearance are assumptions with the stated uncertainty. Frame corner chamfers (about 5 mm) are not modelled; the box is conservative. The shaft cylinder includes the flat's material (conservative). The rotating-part envelope (coupler or pulley) is the caller's part, not this one.

interfaces.source: migration delta R12: the motor bolts face-on (FACE) to a plate by four M3 screws from the plate's far side into its tapped HOLE pattern, at most hole_thread_depth deep (the catalogue's mount block says the same: mount.face_datum, hole_datum, max_screw_engagement)
